findings.title: Do not reassign the existing recreate-upgrade exit code
findings.body: `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` is changed from 4 to 3 while 4 is reassigned to the new feature-disabled condition. The update-compatibility documentation explicitly directs automation to rely on these exit codes, so existing scripts that correctly interpret exit code 4 as "perform a recreate upgrade" will instead treat a normal incompatibility as a disabled feature after upgrading. Preserve the existing recreate code and allocate a previously unused code for feature-disabled (or provide an explicit compatibility/migration path).

findings.title: The feature-gate warning overstates when the operator fails
findings.body: The warning says the operator will fail whenever `rolling-updates` is not enabled, but the accompanying integration test still deploys and updates a Keycloak CR with no `UpdateSpec` and no enabled rolling-updates feature (`UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment(null)`). The gate appears relevant to selecting an explicit update strategy, not to all operator operation. This wording can cause users of the default strategy to believe their otherwise valid deployments are broken; qualify the warning with the configuration that actually requires the feature.
